_readme: Input for Benchmarks/run_benchmarks.py. Predicted GCC flags per program, best first (rank 1 = Top-1). As in PredComp's own harness, the flags apply to hot_file only: the dependent_files are compiled with dependent_flags. meta.root is the folder holding the benchmark programs, relative to the folder this file is in (so fix it if you move this file). Each program lives in root/<program name>, and hot_file and dependent_files are relative to that. compile_args and link_args are the program's normal build arguments. run says how to run the built program from the hot file's folder: the binary with args, with stdin, stdout and stderr redirected from/to the named files (null = not redirected). If loop_count is not null, write it to the file _finfo_dataset in that folder before running (cBench programs read their repeat count from there). output_files are the files to compare between builds to check the program still gives the right answer.
